# LEGOLAND

> > Global family theme park and resort destination featuring LEGO-themed attractions, hotels, and water parks across multiple locations including California, Dubai, and Windsor.

LEGOLAND operates theme parks and resorts worldwide, offering rides like The Dragon and Driving School, themed hotels including Castle Hotel, water parks, and SEA LIFE Aquarium experiences. The parks feature loyalty programs through LEGO Insiders and Annual Pass memberships with exclusive benefits.

- [Partner Hotels Near LEGOLAND California Resort](https://www.legoland.com/california/hotels-packages/hotels/partner-hotels): Partner hotel packages with park tickets and early access benefits
